# PHYSOBJS, RAYCASTING, OBSTRUCTION, OCCLUDER FADING (holtburger-web scene3d + wasm SessionHandle collision layer)
FRAME. Every world child group hangs under worldRoot (scene3d/index.js:1552-1561, rotation.x=-PI/2; children terrain/buildings/statics/cells/entities). Group-local coords are AC world metres: x east, y north, z up, global = lbX*192 + lbLocalX (lbX=(lbId>>>24)&0xff, lbY=(lbId>>>16)&0xff). three world = acToThree(ax,ay,az)=[ax,az,-ay] (adapter.js:1817); acQuatToThree(qw,qx,qy,qz)->Quaternion(qx,qy,qz,qw) (adapter.js:1395). Distances are equal in both frames. Layers: terrain/buildings/statics on layer 0; cellsGroup+entitiesGroup on layer 1 (index.js:1592-1593). The camera enables both (index.js:1650), but atmosphere_pipeline.js CameraLayerMaskPass (:111-124) rewrites camera.layers.mask mid-frame indoors, so a raycaster must set its own mask (picking.js:558 does layers.enable(1)). Heading: LocalPlayerPose.heading and EntityManager.getHeading are CCW yaw (0=north, +PI/2=west); compass = -yaw.

1) ENTITY REGISTRY. window.liveScene3d.entityManager.entityMap is a Map<u32 guid, EntityInstance> (entities.js:4178; set at spawn commit :5568, deleted in remove() :13497). EntityInstance fields (:3733):
- guid
- root: THREE.Group named entity_<guid8hex> (:4737), child of entitiesGroup. root.position is AC world metres. root.quaternion is the AC yaw. root.scale is obj_scale.
- parts[]: per-part Groups.
- meta: plain copy built by loop.js toMeta (:3480). Fields: guid, modelId==setupId (0x02 Setup DID), landblockId (full cell id), x/y/z (LB-local at spawn), qw..qz, wcid, itemType, name, iconId, objScale, physicsTranslucency, paletteId, mtableId, placementId, motionCommand/Stance, vx/vy/vz, physicsScriptDid, soundTableDid, objDescFlags.
- Private fields: _baseScale (:5436), _spawnCellId (:5412), _wireCellId, _attachedParentGuid/_attachedChildren (wielded items are their own entities, parented under the wielder's part node), _stateVisible/_renderCullHidden, _nameplateSprite, _buffBadgeSprite, _speechBubble, _selectionRing, _camFadeOpacity, _objectTranslucency, _ethereal, _wirePos.
- GOTCHA: root.userData.modelId holds the WCID, not the setup (:4747).

EntityManager accessors:
- getHeading(guid): raw CCW yaw or null (:15988).
- getLocalPlayerHeading(): followYaw convention, CW from north (:15938).
- getLocalPlayerWorldPos(): returns the predicted pose first (:15818).
- findGuidByName(name): returns the oldest live guid with that name (:7824).
- getSelectedTarget() / setSelectedTarget(guid) (:8748) / deselectTarget() (:9654).
- isProjectile(guid).

Window globals:
- window.liveScene3d (scene3d/index.js:4420). Exposes the groups, worldRoot, camera (the perspective camera, the same object as cameraSwitcher.persp), cameraSwitcher, cellContainers3d (Map cellId->Group), staticsBakedLbs, buildingsBakedLbs, selectionBracketLayer, nameplateLayer.
- window.__sessionHandle (index.html:4553).
- window.getLocalPlayerGuid() (index.html:3516).
- window.__lastEntityWorldPos: Map guid->{x,y,z,ts} in AC world (loop.js:3959).
- window.__wom: WorldObjectManager (index.html:4704). get(guid).className, byClass('Creature') with taxonomy descendants, snapshot().

Wasm world view (does not depend on spawn gating):
- sh.nearbyEntityGuids(maxRangeM): range measured from the LOCAL PLAYER (d.ts:5232).
- objectPosition(guid) -> Float64Array[lbId,x,y,z] LB-local (:5400).
- objectPartDims(guid) -> Float32Array[radius,height]: CPartArray GetRadius/GetHeight * scale; empty until the Setup is resident (:5386).
- objectPhysicsState, objectName, objectWcid, objectIntProperty.

KIND classification:
- meta.itemType bits (nameplate_sprite.js:371-397 categoryForItemType): CREATURE 0x10, PORTAL 0x10000, LIFE_STONE 0x10000000, CONTAINER 0x200.
- meta.objDescFlags (target_cycle.js:47-49, :135-142, :711-713): PLAYER 0x8, ATTACKABLE 0x10, PK 0x20, UI_HIDDEN 0x80, VENDOR 0x200, DOOR 0x1000, CORPSE 0x2000, LIFESTONE 0x4000, PORTAL 0x40000, BINDSTONE 0x8000000.
- matchesSelectionType (:103).
- GUID tiers: 0x5 players, 0x8 dynamic, 0x7 world-static.

BOUNDS. object_radius.js is NOT a bounding-radius module. It implements ?objRadius=N (default 4): statics and buildings are baked only within Chebyshev N landblocks of the player and hidden beyond N+1. Real bounds sources:
- (a) objectPartDims: cylinder r/h.
- (b) sh.creatureSeparationTable() {setupIds, radii (first cylsphere, else first sphere; unscaled), playerRadius 0.48, epsilon 2e-4} (d.ts:835/3723). Memoised by EntityManager._refreshSeparationTable/_separationFloor (:8980/:9021).
- (c) wasm fetchSetupSelectionSphere(setupId) -> {cx,cy,cz,radius,valid} in object-local space (d.ts:8736/6984). Cached via selection_brackets.js loadDatSelectionSphere (:624) / peekDatSelectionSphere (:614). datSelectionSphereFor(rec,root) (:666) gives the offset plus radius*scale.z. World centre = offset.applyMatrix4(root.matrixWorld) (:954-957).
- (d) computeSelectionSphere(root): Box3 heuristic (:690).
- (e) Fixed ENTITY_CULL_RADIUS = 6 m (entities.js:3018).
- (f) Occlusion AABB _occEntityBox (module-private, :3250): rig Box3 + 0.6 m pad.

2) STATICS / BUILDINGS. staticsGroup holds a mix of node types:
- Singleton Mesh static-<placementKey> (statics.js:1906-1926). userData {modelId, surfaceDid, landblockId, placementKey, isBuilding:false, source:'landblockinfo'|'scenery'}. position is AC world.
- InstancedMesh per (model, surface) (:2107-2135). userData {modelId, surfaceDid, instanceCount, source, sceneryCount, landblockInfoCount, coversLbKeys}; per-instance world matrices.
- LOD wrappers.
- Per-LB staticBatch BatchedMesh.
- statBatchChunk region BatchedMeshes (DEFAULT ON).
- Cross-LB statAtlas BatchedMeshes stat-atlas-x-<bucket> (DEFAULT ON; static_atlas.js:1342-1380; userData.__statAtlasCrossLb; no landblockId; frustumCulled=false, perObjectFrustumCulled=true).
- Static particle meshes (userData.__particle / isParticleInstanced) and default-script anchors.
- Animated scenery (?animScenery default ON).

Buildings: buildings.js:545-625 builds Group building-<placementKey> -> part-N hinge Group -> surface-<did> Mesh, with userData {modelId, landblockId, placementKey, isBuilding:true, partGroups}. BUT ?buildingBatch is DEFAULT ON (buildings.js:127, code reads !== 'off' even though a header comment says default-off), so _feedBuildingGroupsToAtlas (:150) flattens building surfaces into the cross-LB atlas inside staticsGroup. buildingsGroup keeps only the residue. As a result, most statics and buildings lose per-placement identity: atlas membership is a module-private _lbMembership row {bucketKey, gid, iid, texUuid}.

There is NO retained JS placement index. lb_objects_shared.js is a transient cache that drops an entry after 2 reads; it cannot be queried. Ways to enumerate:
- wasm fetch_landblock_objects_soa(Uint32Array.of(lbKey|0xFFFE)) -> LandblockObjectsSoa{len, modelIds, positions (LB-local), quaternions (qw,qx,qy,qz), scales, isBuilding, landblockIds} (d.ts:2153/9070).
- fetch_landblock_scenery_soa -> {objIds (Setup DID), positions, quaternions, scales, defaultScriptId, ...}; it carries no AABBs (d.ts:2184/9114).
- Raw dist/scenery/0xXXYY.scenery.jsonl: rows carry aabb_min/max_x/y/z (LB-local, full model extent including the canopy), obj_id and stable_id.
- EnvCell statics via fetchEnvCellsInLandblock(lb)[i].takeStaticObjects() -> StaticObjectPlacement{did, x,y,z in WORLD coords, q, aabbLocal[6]} (d.ts:7406/8520).
- Spawns via fetch_landblock_spawns_soa.
- Introspect the batches: BatchedMesh getMatrixAt(iid) / getBoundingSphereAt(gid); InstancedMesh getMatrixAt(i).

Tree / rock / building distinction:
- isBuilding.
- source='scenery' (procedural trees/rocks/bushes) vs 'landblockinfo' (props).
- vfx_catalog.js vfxDescriptorFor(did) (:159). Covers 1168 Setup DIDs from dist/vfx/visual_descriptors.jsonl. Archetypes: tip-flex 404, rigid-glint 340, foliage-pollen 269, trunk-canopy 103, gem-sparkle 41, creature-breath 9, brazier 1. Signals: category (Prop 550 / Scenery 437 / Unknown 159 / Interactive_Portal / Creature / Furniture), maxDimension, aspectRatio, partCount.
- tree_wind.js isTreeDid is only a 6-DID allowlist.
- The wasm scenery colliders know Cylinder (trunk) vs Sphere (boulder), but this is not exported to JS.

3) RAYCASTING. picking.js pickEntityAt(clientX, clientY) (:948; exposed as window.__pickEntityAt :1964):
- three r184 Raycaster on layers 0+1.
- Tests only VISIBLE entity roots, recursive into rig parts, near-to-far; skips the local player and hidden parts.
- Fallback: pickBySphere -> pick_math.js pickNearestSphereHit (:46) over part bounding spheres. sphereRayEntry (:20) returns -1 when the ray starts inside the sphere.
- Statics, buildings, terrain and cells are never tested (F7 TODO at :963), and there is no BVH anywhere. So __pickEntityAt returns an NPC that is behind a wall: it is not an LOS test.

three r184 BatchedMesh.raycast (node_modules/three/src/objects/BatchedMesh.js:1382) walks EVERY active+visible instance linearly (bbox/sphere, then triangles) and sets intersect.batchId = instance id; InstancedMesh gives instanceId. A visual raycast into staticsGroup can therefore name the blocking instance, but costs O(all ring instances) per ray.

ragdoll_env.js _collectTargets (:461) / _castAC (:503) is the in-repo pattern for an AC-frame visual raycast against a bounded list of at most 64 meshes from cellsGroup+buildingsGroup, culled by bounding sphere.

WASM SWEEPS on SessionHandle. Shared contract:
- All endpoints are GLOBAL AC world metres.
- Each returns a wasm-bindgen CollisionHit {t in [0,1], x,y,z hit point, normalX/Y/Z pointing back toward the origin} or undefined.
- t~0 means the sweep started embedded. The caller must call hit.free().
- The hit carries NO object identity.

Per-layer sweeps (d.ts / src/lib.rs):
- cameraSweepCollision(fx,fy,fz,tx,ty,tz,r,lbId): coarse building per-part AABBs (d.ts:3496 / lib.rs:43793).
- sweepSphereAgainstBuildingMesh(...,r,lbId): physics triangles of ONE landblock, linear scan (d.ts:6505 / lib.rs:43845 / scene.rs:5854).
- sweepSphereAgainstStatics(...,r,lbId): LandBlockInfo stab AABBs, whole-AABB slab test, over the 3x3 ring around lbId (d.ts:6611).
- sweepSphereAgainstScenery(...,r,lbId): trunk cylspheres and boulder spheres over the 3x3 ring; canopies are not colliders (d.ts:6598 / scene.rs:4974).
- sweepSphereAgainstCellMesh(...,r,Uint32Array cellIds): EnvCell shells (d.ts:6522).
- sweepSphereAgainstCellStatics(...,r,cellIds): furniture BSPs (d.ts:6540).
- sweepSphereAgainstEntities(...,r,maxRangeM): collidable HAS_PHYSICS_BSP objects, i.e. closed doors and chests. Skips the local player; creatures are excluded; open doors are ETHEREAL and skipped (d.ts:6565 / lib.rs:44053).
- sweepSphereAgainstObjects(...,r,missileGuid,exemptLocalPlayer): creatures, players and props by Setup cylspheres/spheres at the wasm body pose. Skips guid==missileGuid, parented objects, contained objects and MISSILE/ETHEREAL objects. missileGuid's own PhysicsState sets the filter: if it is ETHEREAL, only STATIC objects count. Passing the SUBJECT's guid therefore excludes the subject (missile_sweep.rs:144-190).
- clipCameraToCellSpace(...,r,startCell) -> t or undefined (d.ts:3621).
- terrainHeightAt(wx,wy) -> physics z, or undefined if the landblock is not resident (d.ts:6652 / lib.rs:43725). Drawn ground = that + visual_ground.js visualGroundDeltaAt (:466), |dz| <= 8 cm.
- resolveViewerCell / setViewerCell / getViewerCell / getViewerRenderSet / getRenderSet(depth). getRenderSet is the player-rooted BFS.

RESIDENCY. Building, static and scenery collision is populated ONLY for the 3x3 landblock ring around the player: app/landblock_stream.js ensureBuildingAabbsAroundLandblock (:584) calls populateBuildingAabbsForLandblock, populateStaticsAabbsForLandblock and populateSceneryCollidersForLandblock. These are staged and land on the next TickMovement; the collision mirror refreshes at most every 100 ms. EnvCell physics triangles are staged per dungeon landblock on EnvCell load. Check with __diag.collision.residency().

Reference chain: camera.js _clipCameraAgainstWorld (:1769):
- Order: terrain floor (+0.7), building AABB (off), building mesh, statics, scenery, cell mesh, cell statics, entities (range = segment length + 2 m), then indoor cell clamp.
- Retail viewer sphere is 0.3 m from pivot z+1.5, with a 0.02 m skin (viewer_cell.js:44/51).
- Clipping formula: final = start + delta*(t - backoff/len).

projectile_sweep.js sweepProjectileSegment(sh,p0,p1,opts) (:186) already chains the layers and reports the winning layer in opts.out.layer. projectileTerrainCrossing(p0,p1,terrainZAt,eps) (:273) is a pure terrain line-of-sight march with bisection.

4) OCCLUDER FADING. There is NO system that fades or dithers occluders between the camera and the player.
- canopy_soften.js only bends tree-canopy normals for lighting.
- fade_alpha_state.js is a state helper for ENTITY fade owners. Call snapshotAuthoredAlpha(mat) (:71) before writing opacity and syncFadeAlpha(mat) (:94) after. While faded it sets alphaTest 0, NormalBlending, transparent, depthWrite=false; at full opacity it calls restoreAuthoredAlpha.

Entity fade owners (entities.js):
- setLocalPlayerCameraOpacity(guid,o) (:18991): one remembered slot (_localCamFade); hierarchical over held items (?camFadeHier, default ON). camera.js _applyCameraPlayerFade (:2156) pushes nearFadeOpacity each frame in follow mode under ?retailCamZoom (default ON).
- _applyCamFadeToInst(inst,o) (:19098): works on ANY rig; snapshot keys __preCamFadeOpacity / __preCamFadeDepthWrite.
- applyObjectTranslucency(guid,t) (:18870): owned by the server PhysicsDesc translucency; snapshot key __preObjTransOpacity.
- _applyEtherealToEntity.
- All of them clone per-entity materials via _getOrCloneEntityMaterial and cost a program swap when a fade starts.

Statics and buildings can only be HIDDEN:
- Per BatchedMesh instance via bm.setVisibleAt(iid,false).
- Per landblock via parkStaticAtlasForLb / parkStaticBatchXForLb (static_atlas.js:2029, static_batch_x.js:2975; also exposed as liveScene3d._parkStaticAtlasForLb).
- Singleton .visible is rewritten every frame by statics.js cullStaticsGroup (:4510). BatchedMesh nodes are forced visible unless userData.__deadBatch is set.

5) HIDING HUD AND AVATARS.
- ?hud=none: CSS html.no-hud hides all non-#stage DOM (index.html:536-539, 614). It also skips the DOM nameplate layer and the bracket overlay (index.js:3195-3263) and disables sprite nameplates and buff badges (nameplate_sprite.js:311).
- Sprite nameplates are OFF by default (?nameplates=on); DOM nameplates are OFF by default (?nameplateDom=on).
- Selection brackets are ON by default: a DOM div #selection-brackets-3d, which agent-mode CSS FORCE-SHOWS (index.html:525). Disable with ?selectionIndicator=none, or selectionBracketLayer.setDisplayOn(false) (:898; sticks until CharacterOption 0x0E changes), or setSelectedTarget(0).
- The torus selection ring appears only in ring/both mode. ?selectionFlash is OFF; ?spellShapePreview is OFF; ?castRangeRing is OFF; the cast-stability ring is opt-in via localStorage.
- SPEECH BUBBLES are ALWAYS ON with no flag: a Sprite named speech_bubble on root at z+3.05, depthTest false (draws through walls), 4.5 s hold + 1.2 s fade (speech_bubble.js:171/237; EntityManager.showSpeechBubble :7154).
- Entity visibility is the composite stateVisible && !renderCullHidden, written only by _applyEntityVisible (:2972). tickEntityRenderVisibility (:3093) writes only when the cull state CHANGES and never culls the local player.
- Do NOT use setVisibility(guid,false) to hide: via play_effect_vfx noteEntityVisibility it PLAYS the PS_Hidden script.
- An opacity fade to 0 still CASTS SHADOWS, because shadow_caster_list.js walks only `visible`.

6) PHYSICS DATA EXPOSED TO JS.
- __diag.collision (diag/collision.js): selfTest(), residency() (19 counters), audit(), populate(lbId) (async; forces the populate for ANY landblock).
- __diag.physics: local-player drift only.
- __diag.entityTypes: slices __wom.
- No BSP, cylsphere or triangle data reaches JS. Available instead: the sweeps, StaticObjectPlacement.aabbLocal, the scenery JSONL AABBs, creatureSeparationTable, objectPartDims and SetupSelectionSphere.

FRAME ORDER (loop.js _tickPerFrameBody): tickCellVisibility3D (:2857; also resolves the viewer cell and runs occlusion beginFrame) -> tickFrustumCull (:2879) -> cameraSwitcher.tick (:3235) -> entityManager.tick (:3264) -> render.
- The culls use the PREVIOUS frame's camera matrices.
- The GPU occlusion culler (DEFAULT ON) reveals 1-2 frames late, with hide hysteresis of 3 to 24 frames. window.__occlusionCull.off disarms it; .hiddenKeys() returns 'e<guid>' keys and cell ids.
- Entities more than 120 m from the ACTIVE camera stop ticking (MAX_TICK_DIST :2887; ?maxTickDist).
- Every camera consumer resolves cameraSwitcher.activeCamera ?? liveScene3d.camera.

## APIS
- EntityManager.entityMap [scene3d/entities.js:4178]  sig=Map<number /*u32 guid*/, EntityInstance> :: The live rig registry. inst.root.position is AC world metres; inst.meta holds the spawn meta (setupId, name, itemType, objDescFlags, wcid, objScale...). Reach it via window.liveScene3d.entityManager.entityMap.
- EntityInstance [scene3d/entities.js:3733]  sig=class EntityInstance { guid; root: THREE.Group; parts: THREE.Group[]; meta; setPose(x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz) } :: Per-entity rig. root is named entity_<guid8hex> (:4737). root.userData = {modelId: WCID (not setup!), landblockId, name} (:4747). _baseScale holds obj_scale.
- loop.js toMeta (spawn meta schema) [scene3d/loop.js:3480]  sig=toMeta(upd) -> {guid, modelId, setupId, landblockId, x,y,z (LB-local), qw,qx,qy,qz, wcid, itemType, name, iconId, objScale, physicsTranslucency, paletteId, mtableId, placementId, motionCommand, motionStance, vx,vy,vz, modelChanges, textureChanges, subPalettes, physicsScriptDid, soundTableDid, objDescFlags} :: The exact field set on inst.meta, used for subject kind classification and setup lookups.
- EntityManager.getHeading [scene3d/entities.js:15988]  sig=getHeading(guid: number): number | null :: Raw CCW yaw about +Z (0 = north) from root.quaternion. getLocalPlayerHeading() (:15938) returns the negated CW-from-north value.
- EntityManager.getLocalPlayerWorldPos [scene3d/entities.js:15818]  sig=getLocalPlayerWorldPos(): {x,y,z} | null :: Local player AC world pose. Prefers cameraSwitcher.getPredictedPlayerWorldPos(), then the rig, then the 2D map, then __lastEntityWorldPos.
- EntityManager.findGuidByName [scene3d/entities.js:7824]  sig=findGuidByName(name: string): number /*0 if none*/ :: O(1) name->guid lookup. Returns the oldest live entity with that name; useful for resolving script subjects.
- EntityManager.setVisibility [scene3d/entities.js:7092]  sig=setVisibility(guid: number, visible: boolean): void :: Server-state visibility (NoDraw/Hidden/Cloaked). It also calls play_effect_vfx noteEntityVisibility, which plays PS_Hidden/UnHide scripts. NOT safe for film hiding.
- _applyEntityVisible / _setEntityStateVisible [scene3d/entities.js:2972]  sig=function _applyEntityVisible(inst) /* root.visible = _stateVisible!==false && !_renderCullHidden */ :: The single writer of rig visibility (module-private). This is the place to add a film-hide term.
- tickEntityRenderVisibility [scene3d/entities.js:3093]  sig=export function tickEntityRenderVisibility(scene3d, culler) -> {tested, culled, occluded, cellGated} :: Per-frame entity cull. Combines a frustum test (6 m sphere), an optional cullDist, ?rigCellGate and the GPU occlusion culler. Exempts the local player, attached children and light owners.
- EntityManager.setLocalPlayerCameraOpacity [scene3d/entities.js:18991]  sig=setLocalPlayerCameraOpacity(guid: number, opacity: number /*0..1*/): void :: Hierarchical camera fade (body plus held items). Stores ONE remembered slot, _localCamFade, which re-applies after re-dress/respawn.
- EntityManager._applyCamFadeToInst [scene3d/entities.js:19098]  sig=_applyCamFadeToInst(inst: EntityInstance, o: number): void :: Per-rig opacity fade on any entity. Uses snapshot keys __preCamFadeOpacity/__preCamFadeDepthWrite and syncFadeAlpha. Template for a film fade owner.
- EntityManager.applyObjectTranslucency [scene3d/entities.js:18870]  sig=applyObjectTranslucency(guid: number, translucency: number /*0 opaque..1 clear*/): void :: Whole-object translucency owner, driven by the server PhysicsDesc. Multiplicative with snapshot __preObjTransOpacity; server updates overwrite it.
- EntityManager.setSelectedTarget / deselectTarget [scene3d/entities.js:8748]  sig=setSelectedTarget(guid: number /*0 clears*/): void; deselectTarget(): void /*:9654*/ :: Drives the bracket overlay (selectionBracketLayer.setTarget) and the legacy torus. Set 0 for HUD-free capture.
- EntityManager.showSpeechBubble [scene3d/entities.js:7154]  sig=showSpeechBubble(guid: number, text: string, isEmote: boolean): void :: Always-on overhead speech sprite (speech_bubble.js showSpeechBubbleOnEntity :171, removeSpeechBubbleFromEntity :237). Override or gate it during takes.
- SessionHandle.sweepSphereAgainstBuildingMesh [pkg/holtburger_web.d.ts:6505]  sig=sweepSphereAgainstBuildingMesh(from_x,from_y,from_z,to_x,to_y,to_z,radius,landblock_id): CollisionHit | undefined :: Sweeps against building GfxObj physics triangles of ONE landblock (linear scan; scene.rs:5854). Long segments must be swept per landblock crossed.
- SessionHandle.sweepSphereAgainstStatics [pkg/holtburger_web.d.ts:6611]  sig=sweepSphereAgainstStatics(from_x,from_y,from_z,to_x,to_y,to_z,radius,landblock_id): CollisionHit | undefined :: LandBlockInfo stab AABB slab test over the 3x3 ring around landblock_id. Pass the landblock containing `from`, not the player's.
- SessionHandle.sweepSphereAgainstScenery [pkg/holtburger_web.d.ts:6598]  sig=sweepSphereAgainstScenery(from_x,from_y,from_z,to_x,to_y,to_z,radius,landblock_id): CollisionHit | undefined :: Procedural scenery trunk cylspheres and boulder spheres over the 3x3 ring (scene.rs:4974). Canopies are not colliders.
- SessionHandle.sweepSphereAgainstCellMesh / sweepSphereAgainstCellStatics [pkg/holtburger_web.d.ts:6522]  sig=sweepSphereAgainstCellMesh(from..., to..., radius, cell_ids: Uint32Array): CollisionHit | undefined; sweepSphereAgainstCellStatics(same) /*:6540*/ :: Covers EnvCell shell triangles and stab-list furniture BSPs for an explicit cell list. The caller chooses the cells (camera uses getRenderSet(1); film can pass resident dungeon cells).
- SessionHandle.sweepSphereAgainstEntities [pkg/holtburger_web.d.ts:6565]  sig=sweepSphereAgainstEntities(from..., to..., radius, max_range_m): CollisionHit | undefined :: Collidable HAS_PHYSICS_BSP entities: closed doors and chests. Skips the local player and creatures; open doors are ETHEREAL and skipped (lib.rs:44053).

Skips missile_guid (so passing the subject guid excludes the subject), parented, contained, MISSILE and ETHEREAL objects (missile_sweep.rs:144).

Use them for subject cylinders and scene enumeration.

## SEAMS
- [scene3d/entities.js:2972] Composite entity visibility, single writer: _applyEntityVisible (root.visible = stateVisible && !renderCullHidden) => Add an inst._filmHidden term and an exported setFilmHidden(guid, bool). This hides the local avatar, other players or an occluding NPC for a shot without fighting the cull or server state, kills its shadow, and avoids the PS_Hidden script that setVisibility triggers.
- [scene3d/entities.js:19098] Per-rig fade owner _applyCamFadeToInst plus fade_alpha_state snapshot/sync => Clone it into _applyFilmFadeToInst with its own snapshot keys (e.g. __preFilmFadeOpacity) to dissolve entities between the camera and the subject. When a fade reaches ~0, also set visible=false or castShadow=false, because shadows ignore opacity.
- [scene3d/statics.js:4560] cullStaticsGroup honoured-marker pattern (userData.__deadBatch) => Add an honoured userData.__filmHidden marker so singleton or InstancedMesh occluders (signs, props) can be hidden for a shot. Writing .visible directly would be undone the next frame.
- [scene3d/static_atlas.js:2029] BatchedMesh per-instance visibility: setVisibleAt(iid) via raycast batchId; atlas and chunk park seams => Hide the specific atlas or chunk instance (tree, building wall surface) a visual raycast reports as blocking (intersect.batchId), and restore it after the take. Use park/unpark for landblock-wide clears.
- [scene3d/projectile_sweep.js:186] Layered wasm sweep chain with layer attribution: sweepProjectileSegment(opts.out.layer) => Build film_los.js on this pattern. Chunk the segment per landblock. Pass missileGuid = subject guid to sweepSphereAgainstObjects. Add projectileTerrainCrossing for terrain, and return {t, layer, point, normal} to answer 'blocked by what layer'.
- [scene3d/camera.js:1769] Follow-camera clearance chain _clipCameraAgainstWorld (viewer sphere 0.3 m, skin 0.02) => Reference for drone/dolly clearance: sweep the previous film eye to the sought eye through the same layers, clamp, then slerp orientation. It is anchored at the player pivot today, so film needs an arbitrary pivot (e.g. the last valid eye).
- [scene3d/occlusion_cull.js:227] Generic GPU occlusion query OcclusionCuller.want(key, aabb) and window.__occlusionCull => Query 'film:<guid>:<part>' sub-boxes (head/torso/legs) of the subject for a GPU visibility verdict that includes canopies, buildings and terrain. It reveals 1-2 frames late and is disarmed indoors. Alternatively set .off=true during takes to stop NPC pop-in around corners.
- [scene3d/culling.js:274] Active-camera resolution: cameraSwitcher.activeCamera ?? liveScene3d.camera => Many subsystems read this camera: the frustum cull, entity tick gate (entities.js:16068), viewer cell (cells.js:2849), nameplate LOD and picking. The film camera must be the persp or active camera, posed BEFORE tickPerFrame, or culls lag one frame.
- [scene3d/cells.js:2849] Viewer-cell resolution updateViewerCell (head->eye walk from the player cell) plus setViewerCell => For indoor shots far from the player, supply the film camera's cell explicitly (resolveViewerCell from a known-good anchor along the dolly path, or setViewerCell). Feed that cell's render set to the cell-mesh sweeps.
- [app/landblock_stream.js:584] Collision residency driver ensureBuildingAabbsAroundLandblock (3x3 around the player) => Before a drone take, populate buildings, statics and scenery colliders for every landblock on the camera path (or call __diag.collision.populate(lb)), then wait one TickMovement and verify with residency().
- [scene3d/selection_brackets.js:898] Bracket and speech-bubble gates: SelectionBracketLayer.setDisplayOn, EntityManager.showSpeechBubble, removeSpeechBubbleFromEntity => HUD-free capture. Turn brackets off, deselect the target, and gate or override speech bubbles. Bubbles have no flag and depthTest=false, so they draw through walls.
- [docs/url-flags.md:] URL capture flags read once at load: hud=none, agent=1, selectionIndicator=none, nameplates/nameplateDom (off), maxTickDist, objRadius, occlusionCull, nosw => Recommended film boot URL: ?hud=none&agent=1&selectionIndicator=none&nosw=1&maxTickDist=<>=shot range>&objRadius=off (for vistas). Optionally use occlusionCull=off for takes.
- [pkg/holtburger_web.d.ts:9070] Offline obstacle data: fetch_landblock_objects_soa, fetch_landblock_scenery_soa, scenery JSONL aabbs, fetchEnvCellsInLandblock statics.aabbLocal, vfxDescriptorFor => Build per-site obstacle maps (trees and canopies with AABB plus archetype, rocks, props, buildings, dungeon furniture) for shot-candidate generation and JEV scoring without touching the render graph.
- [scene3d/selection_brackets.js:954] Subject framing volume: SetupSelectionSphere plus objectPartDims plus the bracket projection maths => Compute the subject's world sphere and screen rect (centre +/- r along camera right/up, then project) for rule-of-thirds, headroom and fill-ratio checks. objectPartDims gives height for eye-line placement.
- [scene3d/ragdoll_env.js:461] Bounded visual raycast pattern (_collectTargets/_castAC) in the AC frame via entitiesGroup.matrixWorld => Cast a small ray fan from the camera to subject sample points against a budgeted target list (nearby entities minus the subject, staticsGroup batches, buildingsGroup, cellsGroup). Gives visual (not physics) occlusion and identifies the occluder via batchId/instanceId/root.
- [scene3d/target_cycle.js:103] Entity kind classification: meta.itemType/objDescFlags (target_cycle.js), __wom className => Shot grammar by subject kind: NPC/vendor dialogue framing, creature action framing, portal and lifestone establishing shots, door reveals. Also choose which entity types count as soft occluders that may be faded.

## HAZARDS
- [scene3d/entities.js:4747] root.userData.modelId is the WCID, not the Setup DID. The setup lives in inst.meta.setupId / meta.modelId. || mitig: Always read inst.meta.setupId for Setup lookups (selection sphere, separation radii, vfx catalog).
- [scene3d/entities.js:7128] EntityManager.setVisibility(guid,false) routes to play_effect_vfx.noteEntityVisibility. That PLAYS the PS_Hidden script (portal bubbles) on an object whose server state is not NoDraw/Cloaked, and plays UnHide on show. || mitig: Add a dedicated film visibility term in _applyEntityVisible; never reuse setVisibility for cosmetic hides.
- [scene3d/shadow_caster_list.js:74] Opacity fades (camera fade, object translucency, film fade) still cast full shadows: shadow_caster_list.js and three's shadow pass test only `visible`, not opacity. || mitig: At o<~0.05 switch to visible=false, or temporarily set castShadow=false on the faded rig's meshes.
- [scene3d/statics.js:4510] Two writers of .visible: cullStaticsGroup rewrites every staticsGroup child's visible each frame and forces BatchedMesh nodes visible, so a film hide via .visible lasts one frame. object_radius.js writes the same flag. || mitig: Use an honoured marker in cullStaticsGroup, or per-instance setVisibleAt on BatchedMesh, which this pass never touches.
- [scene3d/buildings.js:127] Statics and buildings mostly lose per-placement identity. buildingBatch is DEFAULT ON (code !== 'off', despite a header comment saying default-OFF) and statAtlas/statBatchChunk are DEFAULT ON, so building Groups are flattened into ring-spanning BatchedMeshes with no landblockId/modelId per instance. || mitig: Identify occluders via raycast batchId plus bm.getMatrixAt, or the wasm/JSONL placement data. Use ?buildingBatch=off / ?statAtlas=off only for debugging (big draw-call cost).
- [pkg/holtburger_web.d.ts:752] Wasm sweep hits carry NO object identity; t~0 means an embedded start (the normal faces the start side); CollisionHit boxes leak unless freed; a stale pkg/ lacks newer exports. || mitig: Copy fields then free(). typeof-guard every export (as projectile_sweep.js does). Apply the projectileHitStops rule for embedded hits. Resolve identity in JS afterwards.
- [app/landblock_stream.js:584] Collision data exists only in the 3x3 landblock ring around the PLAYER. statics/scenery sweeps search only the 3x3 ring around the passed lbId; building-mesh sweeps read ONE landblock. A film camera far from the player, or a long LOS segment, silently passes through walls and trees. || mitig: Chunk segments to <=192 m, passing landblockOfWorld(chunkStart). Pre-populate collision for landblocks on the camera path and check __diag.collision.residency().
- [scene3d/projectile_sweep.js:39] Physics differs from visual geometry. The statics sweep is a whole-AABB slab (over-blocks under canopies). Scenery colliders are trunks and boulders only (canopies never block). Awnings, banners and particle smoke have no colliders. || mitig: Use physics sweeps for camera CLEARANCE, and visual raycasts or GPU queries (or the scenery JSONL AABB) for subject VISIBILITY.
- [scene3d/cells.js:2849] getRenderSet(1) is rooted at the player's cell, and cells.js resolves the viewer cell by walking head->eye from the player. An indoor film camera far from the player (behind walls) gets a wrong viewer cell and wrong sweep cell sets. || mitig: Seed the viewer cell from the film camera path and pass dungeon cell ids explicitly (e.g. resident ids from liveScene3d.cellContainers3d keys) to sweepSphereAgainstCellMesh/CellStatics.
- [scene3d/loop.js:2857] Cull timing: tickCellVisibility3D and tickFrustumCull run BEFORE cameraSwitcher.tick in _tickPerFrameBody, so culls use last frame's camera matrices. GPU occlusion reveals are 1-2 frames late with 3 to 24 frame hide hysteresis, so NPCs/interiors can pop in when the camera rounds a corner or whips 90 degrees. || mitig: Pose the film camera before tickPerFrame and call camera.updateMatrixWorld(). Set window.__occlusionCull.off=true during takes.
- [scene3d/entities.js:2887] Entity animation stops for rigs more than 120 m from the ACTIVE camera (MAX_TICK_DIST). Spawn-time LOD reads window.liveScene3d.camera at spawn, and dynamic LOD respawns rigs at band crossings, so telephoto subjects freeze or swap meshes. || mitig: Boot with ?maxTickDist=<max shot distance>. Make the film camera the persp/active camera so the LOD and tick gates measure from it.
- [scene3d/object_radius.js:45] ?objRadius default 4: statics and buildings are baked only within 4 landblocks (Chebyshev) of the player and hidden beyond 5. Wide or aerial vistas show bare terrain past ~800 m. || mitig: Use ?objRadius=off (full 11x11 ring) for establishing shots, after checking memory headroom on the 8 GB laptop / 1070.
- [scene3d/skip_hidden_matrix.js:1] ?skipHiddenMatrix (default ON) leaves matrixWorld of hidden (culled/occluded) nodes stale. A direct .matrixWorld read of a culled subject is wrong. || mitig: Read inst.root.position (AC frame), or call getWorldPosition/updateWorldMatrix, which refresh on demand.
- [scene3d/atmosphere_pipeline.js:111] camera.layers.mask is rewritten mid-frame by CameraLayerMaskPass indoors. Entity subtrees are re-stamped to layer 1 after every re-dress/ReplaceObject (_stampEntityIndoorLayer), so custom-layer hiding does not stick, and a raycaster that copies camera.layers can miss layer 1. || mitig: Give film raycasters an explicit mask (enable 0 and 1). Do not hide via layers.
- [scene3d/camera.js:2156] camera.js under ?retailCamZoom (default ON) pushes setLocalPlayerCameraOpacity(nearFadeOpacity) whenever its quantised value changes in follow mode. setLocalPlayerCameraOpacity keeps ONE remembered slot (_localCamFade), so using it for another guid clobbers the local fade. || mitig: While film mode owns the camera, suspend follow positioning or use a separate film fade owner. Never call setLocalPlayerCameraOpacity for non-local entities.
- [scene3d/picking.js:963] window.__pickEntityAt ignores world geometry (it raycasts entity roots only) and skips the local player, so it reports occluded NPCs as picked. || mitig: Do not use it as an LOS oracle; combine it with sweeps or visual raycasts.
- [node_modules/three/src/objects/BatchedMesh.js:1382] three r184 BatchedMesh.raycast is linear over every instance, and atlas buckets span the whole ring (frustumCulled=false). Static particle meshes are direct children of staticsGroup (userData.__particle), and occlusion proxies and blood decals have raycast=noop. || mitig: Budget a few rays per frame and pre-filter targets by distance (ragdoll_env pattern). Skip __particle/isParticleInstanced nodes. Spread candidate evaluation over frames.
- [scene3d/entities.js:3786] Rendered rig pose differs from the wasm collision pose. sweepSphereAgainstObjects/Entities use the WorldState body pose (not the dead-reckoned root.position), and installVisualGroundRoot adds visualZ-physicsZ (<=8 cm) to the rig MATRIX only. || mitig: Pad subject and occluder radii by ~0.3 m. Treat sweep results near the subject as the subject itself.
- [scene3d/speech_bubble.js:171] Speech bubbles are always on (no flag), depthTest=false, renderOrder 11. Agent-mode CSS force-shows #selection-brackets-3d, so a selected target shows brackets in ?agent=1 captures. || mitig: Use ?hud=none or ?selectionIndicator=none, setSelectedTarget(0), and gate showSpeechBubble during takes.
- [scene3d/camera.js:676] Flag-default footguns: comments and docs say camIndoorObjects is '=on opt-in' but the code is !== 'off' (default ON). The buildingBatch header says default-OFF but the code is default ON. Trust the readers, not the comments. || mitig: Verify flag readers in code before assuming film-relevant behaviour.
- [src/lib.rs:44053] sweepSphereAgainstEntities/Objects use RefCell try_borrow and silently return 'no hit' when a sweep lands mid-drain. Other sweeps read the collision_scene mirror, which is refreshed at most every 100 ms and only after a TickMovement drain. || mitig: For critical decisions, sample over several frames and take the conservative (blocked) answer.

## RECS
- Write an import-free scene3d/film_los.js (node-testable, like pick_math.js/projectile_sweep.js). It takes (sh, camP, subjP, subjectGuid, radius). It runs a terrain march (projectileTerrainCrossing with sh.terrainHeightAt), then wasm layers per <=192 m chunk: buildingMesh(lb of chunk), statics(lb), scenery(lb), cellMesh/cellStatics(explicit cell ids), entities(range), objects(missileGuid=subjectGuid). Return {blocked, t, layer, point, normal}. Copy then free() every CollisionHit and typeof-guard exports, as projectile_sweep.js does.
- Resolve 'blocked by what' in JS after a physics hit. objects/entities layer: nearest inst.root within (objectPartDims radius + 0.5 m) of the hit point. statics/scenery: a short three Raycaster probe at the hit point against staticsGroup BatchedMesh/InstancedMesh (batchId/instanceId), or containment in scenery JSONL AABBs. buildings: the same probe (buildings live in the atlas by default).
- For subject VISIBILITY (not clearance), use a 5-9 ray fan from the camera to points on the subject's DAT selection sphere (center, top, bottom, left, right). Cast against a budgeted ragdoll_env-style target list with raycaster.layers 0+1, skip __particle nodes, and exclude the subject's rig. Report visible-fraction and occluder ids. Optionally cross-check with OcclusionCuller.want('film:<guid>:<k>', subBox) for GPU truth outdoors.
- Add a film visibility owner in entities.js. Add inst._filmHidden to _applyEntityVisible plus an exported setFilmHidden(guid, on) and clearAllFilmHidden(). Use it to hide the local avatar and other players (shadows go too) instead of setVisibility or opacity tricks.
- Add a film fade owner mirroring _applyCamFadeToInst, with its own snapshot keys and snapshotAuthoredAlpha/syncFadeAlpha. Ramp fades over >=0.3 s and pre-warm (the first fade per material costs a program swap). Below ~5% opacity, switch to film-hidden so the shadow disappears.
- For static occluders, add an honoured userData.__filmHidden check in cullStaticsGroup for singletons and InstancedMesh. For BatchedMesh atlas/chunk instances, keep a list of (bm, batchId) from the visual raycast, call setVisibleAt(batchId,false) for the shot, and restore on cut. Never write .visible directly.
- HUD-free capture profile: boot with ?hud=none&agent=1&selectionIndicator=none&nosw=1. Then at runtime call entityManager.setSelectedTarget(0) and override entityManager.showSpeechBubble = () => {} (or add a real ?speechBubbles=off flag) for the duration of a take. Nameplates, spell previews, range rings and selection flash are already default-off.
- Capture-quality toggles: ?maxTickDist >= longest subject distance (default 120 m freezes telephoto subjects). ?objRadius=off for vistas (only if the memory budget allows). window.__occlusionCull.off=true during takes (prevents 1-2 frame NPC/interior pop-in on fast pans). Pose the film camera before tickPerFrame so culls are not one frame stale.
- Before any drone or dolly path, pre-populate collision for every landblock the path crosses (populateBuildingAabbsForLandblock/populateStaticsAabbsForLandblock/populateSceneryCollidersForLandblock, or __diag.collision.populate). Wait one TickMovement and assert residency() counts are non-zero; otherwise the camera clips through walls outside the player's 3x3 ring.
- Indoors, drive the viewer cell from the film camera: resolveViewerCell walked along the dolly path from a known cell, then setViewerCell. Pass explicit resident dungeon cell ids to the cell sweeps instead of getRenderSet(1), and use clipCameraToCellSpace along the path for containment.
- For agent shot planning (outside the per-frame loop), build per-site obstacle maps from fetch_landblock_objects_soa, fetch_landblock_scenery_soa, the raw dist/scenery JSONL (aabb_min/max + obj_id), fetchEnvCellsInLandblock statics.aabbLocal, and vfxDescriptorFor archetypes (trunk-canopy/foliage-pollen = soft foliage, rigid-glint/tip-flex = props, buildings via isBuilding). JEV can score candidates offline from these.
- Subject framing: use loadDatSelectionSphere(wasmExports.fetchSetupSelectionSphere, meta.setupId) and datSelectionSphereFor(rec, inst.root) for the framing sphere. Use objectPartDims for height (eye line ~0.9*height). Reuse the SelectionBracketLayer.tick projection (center +/- r along camera right/up) for screen-rect composition checks.
- Respect the laptop rules when testing: these pieces can be unit-tested with targeted node tests (pure modules taking a mock session handle, as tests for projectile_sweep do). Leave the browser and 1070 validation to the orchestrator.

## OPENQ
- Will film mode drive the existing perspective camera (cameraSwitcher.persp, through a new film mode) or a separate THREE camera? Many consumers resolve cameraSwitcher.activeCamera ?? liveScene3d.camera: culls, viewer cell, tick gate, nameplate LOD, picking. Spawn-time LOD reads window.liveScene3d.camera.position directly.
- Should film hide/fade be a first-class owner? That means a new _filmHidden composite term in entities.js and an honoured __filmHidden marker in statics.js cullStaticsGroup. The alternative is runtime monkeypatching. The first touches two hot files the orchestrator must merge carefully.
- Which source decides obstruction: physics sweeps (cheap, complete only near the player, blind to canopies and awnings), visual raycasts (accurate, O(instances) per ray in three r184), or GPU occlusion queries (whole render, 1-2 frames late, outdoors only, no sample counts in WebGL2)? A hybrid needs a per-shot cost budget.
- How should collision residency be handled for camera paths beyond the player's 3x3 ring: proactive populate*ForLandblock calls (async, applied next TickMovement, insert-only until landblock eviction), or constraining drone paths near the player? Is there a memory cost on the 8 GB laptop / 1070 for wide populates?
- Particle obstruction: no helper exposes emitter world bounds. EntityManager._worldParticleManager.particleTable (Map id->emitter with parent, parentOffset, parts[]), _particleEmittersForGuid and scene3d._staticParticleManager exist, but bounds would need to come from live part meshes. Not verified beyond the constructor fields.
- Is a 'query-only' mode wanted for OcclusionCuller, giving raw per-key results without hysteresis and without hiding rigs, so film can read GPU visibility while disabling occlusion-based hiding during takes?
- Should the follow camera's player-anchored clip chain (_clipCameraAgainstWorld uses the player head as the sweep start) be generalised to an arbitrary pivot for film, or should film_los.js own its own chain?
